title: Simple light detectors
hook: Light sensing need not resemble an eye like ours.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted spots represent simple light-detecting structures at the front of a planarian. The diagram does not show an image of the animal’s surroundings or claim the spots form vision like human eyes.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: A planarian has two simple eyespots. What can those structures help it detect?
